reasoning: 驗證使用者將 Front Park Sense Volume 設為 High 時，TLM 送出 $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PamChimeVolumeFront_Req$ = 2 (High) 至 IPC。關鍵情境為單一音量值之等價分割。本 Req 只述一個值，依 §8.2.2 一 Req 一條，不與其他值合併。規格觸發為內部訊號，依 R-P355 不得直接 Set，改以 UI 選擇觸發並驗其下游 CAN 訊號。label 逐字取 DBC VAL_（2 = High），與規格原文一致。

tcs.tc_title: Front Park Sense Volume set to High
pre_conditions: The named UI element "Front Park Sense Volume" screen is displayed
test_procedure: Select "Front Park Sense Volume" = "High" to trigger $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PamChimeVolumeFront_Req$ signal transmission
Read the named UI element "Front Park Sense Volume" control and check that it is "High"
expected_result: The named UI element "Front Park Sense Volume" control is "High"
tcs.test_item:
The HMI layer shall capture the customer selection for the **PAM Chime Volume Front** setting and send the request using CarPropertyManager.setProperty() with the TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PamChimeVolumeFront_Req signal value set to **High**
(Front chime volume High is transmitted to the IPC)

distinguishing_axis.delta: Front 音量 = 2 (High)，與同族其他值為等價類之不同分割

tcs.remarks: UI element names are taken from the menu item wording named in the spec section and in the 037 description (R-VL21(a)); they are not anchored in HMI Settings List. specification_reference uses the upstream Sys-RA id per R-VL19(b): the spec has no chapter heading for this family (upstream package 04 W-8 measured zero headings containing "Volume")
